PPR 2025 took effect on 28 September 2025; BPPA has since published a 2026 PPA amendment and a Rule 154 clarification. Check the current legal text, portal transition notice, clarification circular, tender issue date, and tender-specific instruction before deciding which provisions apply.
Confirm the e-GP registration type matches the actual bidder: national or international firm, individual consultant, or government-owned enterprise.
For applicable national firms, check incorporation/registration, trade licence, valid TIN and VAT evidence against the live portal's current registration list.
Confirm the organization authorization and administrator identity requirements are current. Avoid storing identity-document numbers in TenderProof.
Confirm any applicable e-GP registration fee is paid and the bidder account is active; verify directly in the portal.
Record the tender reference and the exact portal closing date/time in Bangladesh Standard Time.
Use the current tender document available for this tender on e-GP; record its version and download date.
Review every portal amendment, pre-tender meeting record, and published clarification; treat amendments as part of the tender document.
Map every eligibility, experience, personnel, financial, and technical criterion to dated, verifiable evidence.
Complete the portal forms and required schedules; check every question, criterion, and attachment against the tender document.
Confirm reused e-GP briefcase/library files are authentic, current, legible, and valid for this tender.
Reconcile all quantities, units, arithmetic, taxes, and totals with the official schedule and portal fields; follow this tender's submission structure.
Check whether this tender requires security and verify exact form, amount, validity, and bank workflow from the current tender document and portal. Do not assume a standard amount.
Confirm the authorized representative and the signature method required by the current e-GP process for this submission.
Check file readability, correct tender/field placement, completeness, and final preview before signing and submission.
Submit through e-GP well before the deadline and retain the portal-generated submission confirmation. Late submissions may be rejected.
If awarded, review the NOA response deadline and acceptance steps in the live portal and contract documents.
If required, arrange the specified performance security and complete contract execution according to the NOA and tender-specific terms.
For contracts managed in e-CMS, track the approved work plan, milestones, progress evidence, variations, invoices, and completion records.
